activity_summary: At home you looked at the chronicle and did not write. The page had a king riding in behind another man, and dust thrown on his head. Gib stayed on the book. You added no word.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the page, and wrote nothing.

entities.name: Holinshed
entities.context: Mentioned in A king behind another man

facets.activity: Looked at the king in the chronicle
